title: RegistryIndex
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the master index of all registry entries, anchors, chains, and lineage mappings within the Beast System 3.0 Registry Fabric.

indexId.description: Unique identifier for this registry index instance.

version.description: Version of the registry index schema.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this index was generated.

entries.description: List of all registry entries known to the system.

anchors.description: List of all registry anchors used for blockchain or ledger binding.
